trace.final:
## Summary

**checkout-api has been rolled back and is healthy again.**

**What happened:**
1. **Diagnosed:** v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt partially failed — it completed only in us-east before the orchestrator halted. I verified the state (us-west and eu-west were still on the broken v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate) and retried, which successfully rolled out v2.3.0 to all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident:** INC-0001 was created and the on-call engineer was paged. The incident documents the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the 18% error rate, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the final successful rollout of v2.3.0 to all regions.

**Current state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 across all regions, healthy, with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).
